name: Vedrixa Forms – Registration & Contact Form Builder
author: registrationformbuilder

sections.description:
Vedrixa Forms provides a modern form builder inside wp-admin for creating registration and contact forms.

Features:

  • Drag-and-drop form builder
  • Multiple field types (text, email, dropdown, checkbox, radio, textarea, file, date, and more)
  • Form-level settings (general, limits, post-submission, auto-responder, email templates)
  • Global settings (security, user accounts, email configuration)
  • Frontend rendering via shortcode
  • Admin submission listing and basic filtering

Shortcode:

[wpefb_registration id="FORM_ID"]

External Services

This plugin can connect to Google reCAPTCHA when you enable reCAPTCHA in the plugin settings. reCAPTCHA is used to help protect your forms from spam and automated abuse.

When reCAPTCHA is enabled, the plugin loads Google reCAPTCHA scripts on the frontend form page and sends the visitor’s IP address, browser information, interaction data, and the reCAPTCHA token to Google to validate the submission. It also sends the generated token to Google’s verification endpoint when the form is submitted.

This service is provided by Google:

  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the vedrixa-forms-registration-builder folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Vedrixa Forms” in wp-admin.
  4. Create a form and copy its shortcode.
  5. Paste the shortcode into a page or post.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support both contact and registration forms?

Yes. You can choose form type while creating a new form.

How do I show a form on frontend?

Use the generated shortcode in any page/post, for example:
[wpefb_registration id=”1″].
